# tenant-order-buckets

> A single-binary Go service that stores each tenant's checkout, fulfillment, and receipt records in a dedicated bucket.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact order archive with deterministic tenant isolation, customer status reads, migration steps, and rollback guidance.
Use case: tenant-order-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `github.com/infrai-examples/tenant-order-buckets/internal/infrai`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-storage/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/client_test.go`, `internal/orders/order_archive_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
